documents.title: О принятии под Российскую Державу уступленных от Польши провинций — именной указ № 13850
documents.institution: Российская империя / Полное собрание законов Российской империи

date.note: PSZRI No. 13850; 11-day conversion for the eighteenth century.

documents.publicationCitation: Полное собрание законов Российской империи, Собрание I, т. XIX (1770–1774), № 13850.
documents.notes: The act orders the designated Polish provinces to be taken into effective Russian possession, prescribes an oath, boundary posts and administration, and recites the new boundary using the Dvina, inter-voivodeship boundaries, a straight line toward the source of the Drut/Druec and the Dnieper. It is used for the unilateral Russian-law/effective-possession chronology, not as evidence of Polish consent.

documents.title: Трактат между Российской империей и Речью Посполитой об уступке земель первого раздела
documents.institution: Архив внешней политики Российской империи / official treaty publication
documents.archiveCitation: АВПРИ; published in the Russian diplomatic treaty corpus. The digital documentary publication reproduces the treaty text.
documents.notes: Article II cedes to Russia the first-partition lands and restates the boundary: Dvina, the Vitebsk/Polotsk and three-voivodeship junction, a straight line toward the source of the Druec near Ordva, the Druec to the Dnieper, then the Dnieper while preserving the existing Kyiv district boundary. Article X requires commissioners to mark the boundary.

documents.title: Условия мира России с Бухарой и соглашение 1868 года
authority: Российская империя / К. П. фон Кауфман
documents.publicationCitation: Russian imperial treaty/diplomatic publication; cross-referenced in later Сборник действующих трактатов and the Kaufman archival corpus.
documents.notes: The peace terms place Samarkand and its dependent settlements under the Russian Emperor and define the intended southern and Bukhara-facing boundary framework. History Core uses 5 July 1868 Gregorian as the precise transition for the initial Samarkand/Zarafshan acquisition represented by this change. Later 1870–1871 upper-Zarafshan/Kashkadarya additions are expressly excluded and require separate acts.

documents.title: Воззвание К. П. фон Кауфмана жителям Самарканда и окрестных кишлаков о правах и обязанностях в связи с присоединением к России
documents.institution: Российский государственный исторический архив / Президентская библиотека
authority: К. П. фон Кауфман / Туркестанское генерал-губернаторство
documents.notes: Direct archival corroboration that Samarkand and surrounding kishlaks were treated as incorporated into Russia. Used with the dated peace instrument, not to manufacture a day not present in this archival catalogue record.
